description: He wears an opaque warm brown long open-front coat with wide gold geometric woven borders along the opening, cuffs and hem. A cream long tunic with a simple split neckline lies beneath. A dark brown and gold decorated woven sash wraps the waist, with long fringed ends hanging at the front. Dark brown tall leather boots are fully visible beneath the robe. The clothing has a substantial textured woven appearance; exact fiber is uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
